thesis: The episode explores the intersection of authentic leadership and organizational behavior, challenging the finance industry's dismissal of soft skills like communication and connection. It frames the conversation as a case study in self-exploration, focusing on how high-performing professionals define their work's purpose and navigate the tension between their public image and their essential nature.
